correctness.rationale: The anti-automorphism normal form follows from preservation of A^2 and the free quadratic multiplication; direct squaring yields L²=1 and hL+Fh=0. In odd characteristic, T is diagonalizable with trace n(2r−n), proving the exponent. In even characteristic, swapping-basis Jordan blocks make F a permutation with n fixed words, giving Hom_{k[C2]} dimension rn(n+1)/2+sn²; the standard endomorphism-algebra radical calculation yields the linear-part centralizer order. Exact conjugation by u_g induces image(I−T), whose quotient has dimension rn. Checker independently tests original identities, ranks, and actual IA orbits in bounded cases.

value.rationale: The natural involutive anti-multiplicative structure on a universal nilpotent associative algebra is classified by explicit finite-field counts for every rank, including characteristic two. The q^{rn} identity-linear conjugacy obstruction is a structural modular phenomenon and yields a complete, nontrivial conjugacy refinement; it cannot be inferred from the mere cardinality or from a classical odd-characteristic eigenspace calculation.
